title: Normalized model completion
description: A model response after wire parsing, before the provider (C2) turns it into a thought and an action. Text with no tool calls becomes a finish (C2).

text.description: The visible reasoning/answer text (the thought, or the final answer), with any `<think>` reasoning block stripped (C2).

reasoning.description: Private model reasoning stripped from a `<think>` block (C2); never part of the answer. Absent or empty when the model did not think aloud.

tool_calls.description: Tool calls requested this step; empty or absent means the text is the answer.

plan.description: Optional plan update (C1): when present it replaces the session plan. Absent means the plan is unchanged. A provider parses it from the model's fenced `plan` block (C2).
